subject: spa
source: Cambridge IGCSE Spanish – Foreign Language (0530) syllabus for examination in 2025, 2026 and 2027 (topic areas A–E and grammar list) — Cambridge International; Year 10 covers topic areas A and B and begins C, with core tenses

weeks.topic: Self, family and friends: personal details and family (ser, tener)
objectives: Introduce yourself with name, age, birthday and nationality
Describe family members using ser and tener
Use possessive adjectives mi, tu, su

weeks.topic: Describing people: appearance and personality (adjective agreement)
objectives: Describe hair, eyes and height
Describe personality with correctly agreeing adjectives
Use muy, bastante and un poco

weeks.topic: Friends and relationships (llevarse bien, reflexive verbs)
objectives: Describe relationships with family and friends
Use llevarse bien/mal con and reflexive pronouns
Give reasons with porque

weeks.topic: Time expressions and daily routine (reflexive verbs, telling the time)
objectives: Tell the time and use days, months and seasons
Describe a daily routine with reflexive verbs

weeks.topic: In the home: rooms, furniture and household chores (hay, estar)
objectives: Describe your home and bedroom
Use hay and estar with prepositions of place
Talk about household chores

weeks.topic: Food and drink: meals and eating habits (gustar, encantar)
objectives: Name foods and drinks for each meal
Express likes and dislikes with gustar and encantar

weeks.topic: Shopping for food: quantities and prices (numbers, demonstratives)
objectives: Use numbers and prices in euros
Ask for quantities
Use este, ese and aquel

weeks.topic: At the restaurant: ordering and complaining (querer, poder, usted)
objectives: Order food and drink politely using usted
Use querer and poder + infinitive
Make a simple complaint

weeks.topic: Healthy lifestyle: diet and exercise (deber, hay que, tener que)
objectives: Give advice on healthy living
Use deber, hay que and tener que + infinitive

weeks.topic: The human body, illness and at the doctor's (doler, estar)
objectives: Name parts of the body
Describe symptoms using me duele and estar
Understand simple advice from a doctor

weeks.topic: Leisure time: hobbies and free time (stem-changing verbs)
objectives: Describe hobbies and how often you do them
Use stem-changing verbs jugar, preferir and poder

weeks.topic: Sport: what I did last weekend (preterite of regular verbs)
objectives: Describe sports and activities
Form the preterite of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs

weeks.topic: Clothes, colours and accessories (comparatives)
objectives: Describe clothes and colours with agreement
Compare items using más … que, menos … que and tan … como

weeks.topic: Going out: invitations and arrangements (ir a + infinitive)
objectives: Make, accept and decline invitations
Arrange where and when to meet using the immediate future

weeks.topic: Review: self, family, home, food, health and leisure (present and preterite)
objectives: Revise topic vocabulary from term 1
Practise present and preterite tenses in short writing tasks

weeks.topic: Travel and transport: means of transport and journeys (por, para)
objectives: Describe how you travel and why
Buy tickets and ask about times
Use por and para

weeks.topic: Past holidays (preterite of irregular verbs: ir, ser, hacer, tener)
objectives: Describe a past holiday
Use irregular preterite forms fui, hice and tuve

weeks.topic: Holiday accommodation: hotels and campsites (conditional: me gustaría)
objectives: Book a hotel room or campsite pitch
Use me gustaría and quisiera
Ask about facilities

weeks.topic: Describing past experiences: the imperfect tense
objectives: Describe what places and people were like using the imperfect
Contrast imperfect and preterite

weeks.topic: Directions and getting around town (imperative)
objectives: Ask for and give directions
Use formal and informal imperatives

weeks.topic: The built environment: my town and local services (superlatives)
objectives: Describe your town, buildings and services
Use superlatives el más … de

weeks.topic: Shopping: clothes shops, sizes and returns (direct object pronouns)
objectives: Shop for clothes and ask for sizes
Return items and explain problems
Use lo, la, los and las

weeks.topic: Weather and climate (hace, está, weather verbs)
objectives: Describe the weather and seasons
Use hace, está nublado and llueve/nieva

weeks.topic: The natural world and environmental problems (deber, se debería)
objectives: Describe environmental problems
Suggest solutions using se debería

weeks.topic: Protecting the environment: recycling and saving energy (es importante que + subjunctive)
objectives: Describe what you do to help the environment
Use es importante que with the present subjunctive

weeks.topic: Communications and technology: mobile phones and social media (opinions)
objectives: Talk about how you use technology
Give advantages and disadvantages
Use creo que and pienso que

weeks.topic: Mid-year exams: listening, reading and writing on topic areas A–C
objectives: Complete timed listening, reading and writing papers
Review common grammar errors

weeks.topic: The digital world: online safety and digital habits (perfect tense)
objectives: Discuss online risks and safety
Use the perfect tense he usado and he visto

weeks.topic: People and places: countries, nationalities and compass points
objectives: Name countries and nationalities with correct agreement
Locate places using norte, sur, este and oeste

weeks.topic: Spanish-speaking countries: geography and culture
objectives: Describe features of Spain and Latin American countries
Compare them with Brazil

weeks.topic: Festivals and celebrations in the Hispanic world
objectives: Describe festivals such as el Día de los Muertos and la Semana Santa
Describe how you celebrate a festival

weeks.topic: Writing skills: messages, emails and short descriptions (Paper 4)
objectives: Write short messages covering all bullet points
Use connectives and opinions to develop answers

weeks.topic: Speaking skills: role plays (Paper 3)
objectives: Respond to role-play prompts
Ask and answer questions in formal and informal register

weeks.topic: Measurements and materials: describing objects (de madera, de plástico)
objectives: Describe size and shape of objects
Say what objects are made of

weeks.topic: Reading strategies: cognates, false friends and multiple-choice questions (Paper 2)
objectives: Use cognates and context to infer meaning
Avoid false friends
Approach multiple-choice reading tasks

weeks.topic: End-of-year exams: all four skills on Year 10 topics
objectives: Complete listening, reading, speaking and writing assessments
Reflect on progress in each skill

weeks.topic: Review: tenses and topic vocabulary from Year 10
objectives: Correct errors from end-of-year exams
Consolidate present, preterite, imperfect and immediate future
